pages.title: Enemy Tachi
pages.text: Tachi-type monsters. They possess average attack speed, damage, and spawn frequency.

pages.name: Enemy Tachi
pages.text: The basic tachi unit of the Retrograde Army. Comparable in size to the player, with slower attack speed.

pages.name: Enemy Specialized Tachi
pages.text: A specialized enemy tachi with slightly increased attack power and movement speed, posing a greater threat.

pages.name: Enemy Kiwame Tachi
pages.text: The Kiwame form of enemy tachi, possessing higher attack speed and damage. A relatively high threat.
